college_presence: Operating on River Campus today (Wilson Commons). Nationally, licensed Starbucks cafes are a standard fixture in university unions.
consumer_perception: Near-universal brand recognition; 'third place' study/social positioning; mobile order + Rewards drive habitual repeat visits; frequently named by price-sensitive students as the expensive option.
sources: Third-party menu aggregators (fastfoodmenuprices.com; starbucksmenu.us; starbucksreserveonly.com) - not verified in-store

college_presence: Operating on River Campus today (Wegmans Hall). Nationally a much smaller footprint than Starbucks, with far lower unaided brand awareness among students.
consumer_perception: Positioned on roast craft/quality rather than value; lower brand recognition may mean some students do not register it as a distinct alternative to Starbucks.
sources: Third-party menu aggregators (allmenuguide.com; mealsprices.com) - not verified in-store

college_presence: Real, documented on-campus locations: University at Buffalo (named 'Official Coffee of UB Athletics'), Carleton, Ottawa, Manitoba, UBC, UTSC. UB is in the same western-NY region as Rochester.
consumer_perception: Positioned squarely against Dunkin' as a value everyday-coffee brand; regional strength grows closer to the Canadian border, a corridor Rochester sits within.
sources: fastfoodmenuprices.com (hot coffee, dated May 2026); ubbulls.com (UB Athletics sponsorship); university dining pages (Carleton, uOttawa, U Manitoba, UBC, UTSC) - price for large iced latte not confirmed, figure shown is medium

college_presence: Few if any true in-building campus locations; drive-thru locations cluster near college towns and are described in marketing research as a 'campus must.'
consumer_perception: 80% of orders are customized; strong TikTok/Instagram culture (2.3M+ #DutchBros views); friendly 'broista' service and community-giving reputation drive loyalty specifically with under-25 customers.
sources: Menu aggregators (dbrosmenu.us; thedutchbrosmenu.com) for price range; Infinite Agency and Kerin & Hartley Marketing analyses for Gen Z positioning - both price figures are the midpoint of a wide regional range, not a specific verified price

college_presence: Rarely embedded on campus, but a location is almost always within walking/driving distance of any campus; explicitly marketed to budget-conscious young adults, including free-drink promotions for HS/college graduates.
consumer_perception: Seen as the reliable cheap fallback versus Starbucks/Dunkin'; sets the psychological price floor for the category.
sources: hackthemenu.com; macmenus.us; mcd-menu.us - large_hot_coffee_price shown is a basic small/entry price, not confirmed at large size; large iced latte price not confirmed, large_iced_latte_price shown is the large iced coffee (not latte) price as a proxy
